remarks: City lifestyle at it's best!  In downtown Stamford, walk to restaurants, theaters and shopping! Updated and newly painted, this spacious 1 BR unit is the largest one bedroom floor plan in The Classic, with TWO full bathrooms, and a oversized living room with room for a sectional, a dining area, and an office!  Located on the seventh floor with large windows and sliders to the balcony that provides stunning city views! Enjoy one level luxury living in this elevator building, with a 24/7 concierge. Dark hardwood floors throughout with a gourmet kitchen and granite counters. Stainless-steel oven, microwave, dishwasher. Renovated primary bathroom. Multiple closets with custom built-ins. Extra large balcony with two sliding doors to access. Washer/Dryer in unit. Indoor assigned garage space included.  Building Amenities: Indoor Rooftop Pool, Fitness Center, Rooftop Deck, Third Floor Outdoor Space With Gas Grills. The Stamford Train Station is 1 Mile.
